summary: Review and refresh both exact Firefox warning baselines after every open web PR was folded into one branch for master (#1115 with #1099 and #1104). The same 36 warnings remain: 35 DANGEROUS_EVAL and one UNSAFE_VAR_ASSIGNMENT, at the same sites with the same messages; zero errors or notices.
review: Both configurations were first built from the reference 0cefbaa6 (#1115's head, which holds the Yatagarasu brand) with the same toolchain. The keyless build passed the committed --ci baseline and the store build passed the committed store baseline, so the toolchain reproduces both.

The keyless build is CI's recipe (the Firefox extension build with no NODE_ENV). The store build is the same command under the release provider configuration through env-cmd; that configuration was not printed or recorded.
Compared with line and column ignored, the consolidated builds have the same warning sites as the reference in both configurations: code, file (content hash removed) and message, 36 of 36.

Compared by the 60 characters of minified code on each side, 35 of 36 sites are identical. The remaining one is lodash's global fallback Function(`return this`)() in chunks/mountApp.js, a previously reviewed site; only the minifier's identifier names around it changed, because mountApp.js now also carries #1099's swap form and #1104's password screens.

Per file, only the content hashes in two vendor chunk names change (chunks/background-vendor/bcryptjs-*.js and subwallet-keyring-*.js), with the same warning count in each. Their code is the same: bcryptjs (310,025 bytes in both) differs only in the name it imports from the shared base-x chunk, whose exports were renumbered, and subwallet-keyring (881,327 to 881,333 bytes) only in minified identifier names.

The strict warning verifier and both warning policies are unchanged, and their self-tests pass. New warnings, errors, notices, fingerprint drift and warning-bearing artifact drift remain blocking. The ci-named file is the local keyless-build fixture; no hosted CI was required or modified.
